legend: Munir and Matthew are playing a high-stakes game on an n×m$$$n\times m$$$ grid. They take turns placing rectangles of size at most k$$$k$$$ on the board. It is not allowed to place rectangles that overlap with an existing rectangle on the board. The first player who is unable to place a rectangle loses.
Assuming both players play optimally, with Munir playing first, who wins?
input: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases t (1≤t≤103)$$$t\ (1\le t\le 10^3)$$$. The description of the test cases follows.
The only line of each test case contains three integers n,m,k (1≤n,m≤103,1≤n⋅m≤103,1≤k≤n⋅m)$$$n, m, k\ (1\le n,m\le 10^3, 1\le n\cdot m\le 10^3, 1\le k\le n\cdot m)$$$.
It is guaranteed the sum of n×m$$$n\times m$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 103$$$10^3$$$
output: For each test case, print 'Munir' (without quotes) if Munir wins. Otherwise, print 'Matthew'.
note: In the third sample case, one way Munir can win is by playing a 3×2$$$3\times 2$$$ rectangle to split the board into two halves.

legend.ai: Munir 和 Matthew 正在一个 n×m$$$n\times m$$$ 的网格上进行一场高风险的游戏。他们轮流在棋盘上放置大小不超过 k$$$k$$$ 的矩形。不允许放置与棋盘上已有矩形重叠的矩形。第一个无法放置矩形的玩家输掉游戏。
假设双方都采取最优策略，且由 Munir 先手，谁会获胜？

input.ai: 每组测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 t(1≤t≤103)$$$t\ (1\le t\le 10^3)$$$。下面给出各测试用例的描述。
每个测试用例仅包含一行，其中有三个整数 n,m,k (1≤n,m≤103,1≤n⋅m≤103,1≤k≤n⋅m)$$$n, m, k\ (1\le n,m\le 10^3, 1\le n\cdot m\le 10^3, 1\le k\le n\cdot m)$$$。
保证所有测试用例中 n×m$$$n\times m$$$ 的总和不超过 103$$$10^3$$$

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，如果 Munir 获胜，则输出 'Munir'（不含引号）；否则输出 'Matthew'。

note.ai: 在第三个样例中，Munir 可以通过放置一个 3×2$$$3\times 2$$$ 的矩形，将棋盘分成两半，从而获胜。
